title: AC7 abuse posture has zero test coverage on the four new exit-route POSTs (incl. the stop-must-not-object case)
detail: AC7 = NONE. The nine rc3-4 integration tests never fill the honeypot or trip timing on any of the four new POSTs; existing fake-success pins cover only /answer (reference_form_integration_test.gleam:474). The load-bearing stop branch above is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add integration tests: honeypot-filled and timing-suspicious POSTs to submit/decline/stop/wrong-person return the fake-success page (200) and persist nothing; for stop assert status stays 'contact_initiated' and objection_log count 0.

title: notify_reference_completed/declined/objected and the late_after_handoff branch have no test
evidence:
348:pub fn notify_reference_completed(
387:pub fn notify_reference_declined(
416:pub fn notify_reference_objected(
447:fn dispatch_reference_notification(
detail: grep of server/test for notify_reference/ReferenceCompleted/ReferenceDeclined/ReferenceObjected: 0 matches. AC1/AC3/AC4 'dispatches' clauses unpinned: no assertion of the in-app notification row, the maybe_send_email preference gate, or the taken_over_at late-completion copy.
recommended_fix: In the per-path integration tests seed notification_preference and assert the notification row (type/title) after submit/decline/stop; add a taken_over_at-seeded submit asserting the 'after all' completion body.

title: The four new audit terminal events are written but never asserted
detail: No rc3-4 test queries audit_log for reference_call_completed/declined/objected/wrong_person (grep: 0 matches). The AGENTS.md invariant 'Audit-log writes fire on ... status changes' stays unpinned for these new status changes.
recommended_fix: Assert one audit_log row per terminal event in the per-path tests (event string + entity_type 'reference_call'), e.g. count audit_log WHERE entity_type='reference_call' AND event='reference_call_objected'.

title: purge_after, submitted_at and the denormalised fraud_signals column are never asserted
evidence:
result          = $2::jsonb,
    fraud_signals   = $3::jsonb,
    submitted_at    = now(),
    purge_after     = CASE WHEN $4 = '' THEN purge_after
detail: AC1 clauses for purge_after-from-retention_due_at, submitted_at and the fraud_signals copy: grep of the new tests for fraud_signals/submitted_at/purge_after returns 0. A bug in the $4='' CASE or the JSONB write would go unnoticed.
recommended_fix: In submit test, seed application.retention_due_at, assert purge_after equals it and submitted_at is non-null; assert fraud_signals->'form_session' exists with focus_seconds_reported.

title: AC2 pin asserts only the 303, not that nothing re-persisted
detail: The second POST's test would catch a re-write (it would return 200 thank-you), but never asserts result/submitted_at/audit unchanged. Low risk: the handler redirects via classify before any write, so no dup path is reachable.
recommended_fix: Capture submitted_at/result after the first POST and assert they are unchanged after the second (belt-and-braces on the 303).

title: The three GET confirm pages are untested, incl. the AC4 pre-fetch-safe stop GET
evidence: fn exit_get(config: ServerConfig, token: String, page: String) -> Response {
detail: No test GETs /decline, /stop or /wrong-person: neither the 200 render with the confirm form nor AC4's 'GET mutates nothing' pre-fetch safety is pinned. form_pages_test covers only rc3-3 pages (grep for the new testids: 0).
recommended_fix: Add per-route GET tests asserting 200 + data-testid, plus a stop-GET test asserting status stays 'contact_initiated' and objection_log count stays 0.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: Per-AC coverage: AC1 55%, AC2 80%, AC3 57%, AC4 63%, AC5 100%, AC6 90%, AC7 0%, AC8 100%, AC9 100% → overall ≈72% (<80%) and P1 AC7 <80%: FAIL per the thresholds. Unit suite verified green (1418 passed, 448 skipped); AC5/AC8 tests are genuinely biting.
recommended_fix: Add the AC7 honeypot/timing fake-success tests (stop must NOT object) plus notification and audit_log assertions; that lifts AC7 to 100% and AC1/AC3/AC4 above 90%, passing the gate.
